title: Activation Maps
description: Generate attribution maps for a vision classifier and review the controls needed for responsible interpretation.
objectives: Connect a classifier artifact and its matching crop dataset.
Review attribution, validation, display, quantification, and output categories.
Run a small interface demonstration and distinguish it from biological interpretation.
prerequisite: For meaningful results, use a validated spaCR vision model and the same channel order, crop size, normalization, and object type used during training.

scenes.narration: Activation Maps asks what image regions influence a trained vision model's prediction. The console records artifact loading, attribution batches, map grids, progress, output paths, and reproducibility records.
